svg.title: One backbone, three restoration objectives
svg.desc: Matched inputs and identical U-Net architectures; independently trained pixel regression, perceptual regression and conditional flow matching. Regression uses one forward pass. Flow matching integrates a masked velocity field with Euler sampling.
